title: RiskSurface
description: The computed composite flood risk output for one AOI: a normalized 0-1 continuous raster (the weighted-overlay AHP score), not the 1-5 display classes — discrete classes are derived from this value separately, at display/legend time, and are never what gets stored or cached here. Keyed by a hash of (AOI + criteria set + weights) so identical requests can be served from cache instead of recomputed.

cache_key.description: SHA-256 hex digest of a canonical serialization of (AOI bbox + the AOI's true polygon shape, when present + the set of criterion ids used + their final weights + a stable fingerprint of each criterion's reclassification_rules). Two requests that hash to the same cache_key are considered identical and may reuse the same stored surface — reclassification_rules must be included here, not just criterion_id/weight, since two requests for the same criterion can legitimately submit different breaks (e.g. the frontend's classification editor) and must never collide on the same cached result.

aoi.description: The AOI this surface was computed for.

criteria_set.description: The criteria and final weights used to compute this surface, snapshotted at compute time (independent of any later change to a Criterion's stored weight).

reclassification_rules.description: Snapshotted alongside criterion_id/weight for the same reason: the cache_key must change if this changes, since it changes what the resulting surface actually means. See cache_key's own description.

grid.description: The common analysis grid this raster is stored on. See SPEC.md, 'Grid/resolution convention' — origin is derived deterministically from the AOI so repeated requests for the same AOI produce an identical pixel grid.

origin_x.description: X coordinate (EPSG:32645, meters) of the grid's top-left corner.

origin_y.description: Y coordinate (EPSG:32645, meters) of the grid's top-left corner.

data_url.description: Location (path or URL) of the stored raster data — a single-band float raster with values in [0, 1].

nodata_value.description: Nodata sentinel used in the output raster, e.g. for pixels outside the AOI or where an input criterion was nodata. null means every pixel in the grid carries a valid value.

value_range.description: Fixed [0, 1]. The composite score is always normalized to this range; it is not the 1-5 risk class scale.

created_at.description: When this surface was computed and cached.
